      The Samsung Galaxy A56 is that quiet kid who shows up to the party in sweatpants and somehow leaves with everyone’s attention. It’s got that sleek, water-resistant body, a 120Hz AMOLED screen smoother than your best pickup line, and battery life that clings on longer than your last situationship. But the real magic? Awesome Intelligence. Circle to Search lets you draw a lasso around anything and summon Google like it’s your digital genie. Object Eraser wipes away photobombers and exes with the casual grace of “we don’t know her.” Best Face combines everyone’s best angle like a peace treaty for group selfies. And the Remaster tool? It turns pixelated memories into glow-ups—basically Photoshop without the emotional damage. This phone doesn’t just have brains, it has a sense of humor, and it totally gets you.

      I bought the Samsung Galaxy A56 5G for my mom and appears to be a solid mid-range smartphone that offers a good balance of features and value. The side-mounted fingerprint reader is generally considered quick and convenient, which is great for easy unlocking. The battery life from the 5,000mAh battery seems decent for daily use. While some reviews mention the camera is good for the price, the highlight for my mom is definitely the inclusion of the "#Awesomeintelligence" features. #Awesomeintelligence Features aim to make everyday tasks simpler and more intuitive using AI. Particularly useful: * Circle to Search with Google: This is a very intuitive feature where she can simply circle anything on the screen with her finger to quickly search for it on Google. For example, if she sees a flower in a picture someone sent, she can just circle it to find out what it is. * Object Eraser: This tool allows removing unwanted objects from photos. If a picture has something distracting in the background, she can easily get rid of it. * Read Aloud: This feature can read out web pages, which could be helpful if her eyesight gets tired from reading. * AI Select: This offers contextual suggestions based on what's on the screen, making certain actions quicker. For instance, it might suggest scanning a QR code if one is detected in an image. It's great that she's enjoying these AI capabilities! They are designed to enhance usability and convenience. And she will really love to receive a free smart 💍 ❤

      The A56 is like that guy in your crew who’s not the loudest, not the most stylish—but he’s the most reliable. He’ll hold it down, deliver when you need it, and never make excuses. It’s a solid phone for someone who wants to do the basics with a touch of flair: social media, music, binge-watching, even light editing and content creation. Just don’t expect it to be a beast at gaming or heavy multitasking. If you’re not trying to flex but want something that looks good, feels high-end, and does almost everything well—this is your phone. But if you’re the type who wants max speed, pro-level cameras, and no compromises—you’ll feel the limits eventually.

      How it works

      • 01

        Choose the old device you want to trade-in and confirm its condition based on the criteria provided.

      • 02

        Prepare your old device for evaluation: back up all data, remove any SIM and/or microSD cards, and ensure the battery is charged. Our trade-in partner will contact you for door step evaluation or pick up within 5 days of receiving your new device.

      • 03

        Once the evaluation is completed, you will receive the amount agreed upon by cash for Mobiles, Tablets & Wearables, or by bank transfer for Televisions.

      Only Samsung devices are available for trade-in.       Enter your IMEI (or if you have a Wi-Fi only device, enter the serial number)

      To determine the IMEI number or serial number, enter the combination * # 06 # * on your smartphone or find it on the sticker on the device

        Enter the combination *#06#* on your device.

      • Method2

        Find it on the sticker on the original package of device.
